review_scope: Visual browser screenshot review of the eight current captures only
findings: All eight complete screenshots inspected from header through footer. Text is readable, category names remain intact, and wrapping is natural at 320, 390 and 430 px.
The 600 px styled desktop layout has balanced columns and consistent spacing. Stripped styles use a coherent single column fallback with no excessive empty columns.

Furniture photographs retain natural square proportions without stretching, clipped furniture or disrupted ordering. Each category image remains associated with its own heading and CTA after stacking.
Primary buttons remain clear, contained and visibly padded. Category link targets are aligned under their associated content.
Recorded CTA target heights are at least 46 px in all views; primary buttons are 56 px high.
Current HTML SHA256 matches every capture record; actual JPG hashes match recorded screenshot hashes. All images are marked loaded and all category photo and CTA URLs match in the capture metrics.
No horizontal overflow, broken names, overlapping text, missing photos, detached CTAs or layout defects observed.
browser_only_limitation: These are browser renders, including removal of head styles and font links. They do not verify Gmail, Omnisend, Outlook or any live delivered email. This review did not perform a platform send, import or click test.
